
# RetailX
Version: 1.0

## Summary
RetailX is a premium static website development service offering bespoke static business websites delivered in five working days for a flat development fee of ₹1599. The platform emphasizes mobile-first design, fast-loading static architecture, conversion-oriented layouts, deployment, and WhatsApp-based onboarding.

## Mission
Help businesses launch modern, high-performance static websites quickly without CMS complexity.

## Target Audience
- Small businesses
- Retail businesses
- Startups
- Entrepreneurs
- Service providers
- Personal brands

## Core Value Proposition
- Flat fee pricing
- 5 working day delivery
- Mobile-first
- Static architecture
- Deployment included
- WhatsApp-first onboarding

## Products & Services
### Premium Static Website
Includes:
- Bespoke static website
- Responsive/mobile-first design
- Conversion-focused layout
- Deployment
- Project onboarding

### Optional
- Custom domain (billed separately)
- Free RetailX subdomain
- WhatsApp integration on request

## Pricing
Development: ₹1599
Domain registration: billed separately.

2. Share assets

7. Build

9. Launch
